name: bestie
title_zh: 会先问你要不要改的编程搭子，不擅自碰你代码
tagline_zh: 受够 Agent 自作主张乱改文件？它每次动手前先问你一句，像靠谱同事一样等你点头才碰键盘，代码主权在你手里。
tagline_en: Tired of agents rewriting files on their own? This one waits for your OK before every change—like a respectful.
desc_en: a coding agent that respects you 🥺
why_zh: 把「尊重」做成硬机制：每次修改前显式征求同意，而不是事后让你 review diff。
why_en: Respect is enforced in the workflow: explicit consent before each edit, not after-the-fact diff review. Kills the 'AI went.
limit_zh: 只适用于编码协作场景，不处理部署、运维或设计任务。它需要你主动参与确认，不适合无人值守的自动化流水线。
limit_en: Coding collaboration only—no deploy, ops, or design tasks. Needs your active sign-off; not for unattended CI-style automation.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: A coding agent that asks before touching your code
